# Antigravity Finder Explorer (`finder-explorer`) **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) A lightweight, zero-dependency local plugin for **Google Antigravity 2.0** that adds native **Right-Click → "Reveal in Finder"** workspace file navigation and **Inline "Reveal in Finder" Chat File Bars** directly next to files generated by the AI agent. --- ## Why This Plugin? In Antigravity 2.0's default Auxiliary Pane: 1. Right-clicking a preview tab only displays tab controls (`Keep Open / Close Tab`), and right-clicking items in the built-in `Workspace` tree only displays `Copy`. 2. Clicking file links in chat previews them inside the app, but offers no one-click way to reveal deliverables (such as compiled `.pdf`, `.docx`, or `.png` figures) in macOS Finder or open them directly in Preview / Microsoft Word. **`finder-explorer`** bridges both gaps seamlessly in a single plugin bundle: | Surface | What It Adds | User Interaction | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1. Inline Chat File Bar** *(MCP App + Rule)* | Automatically renders an interactive action bar whenever the agent delivers key files in chat | • Click **`📍 在 Finder 中显示`** (or **double-click** filename) → highlights the exact file in Finder (`open -R`)
• Click **`打开`** → opens in default OS app (Preview, Word, Excel, etc.)
• **Single-click** filename → previews in Antigravity's side-pane tab | | **2. Side-Pane File Tree** *(Sidecar UI Panel)* | Adds a **`Finder 文件树`** panel in the right-hand Auxiliary Pane (`Workspace ⌄` switcher / `+` menu) | • **Right-click** any file or folder → context menu with **Reveal in Finder**, **Open in Default App**, **Preview in Tab**, **Open in Terminal**, and **Copy Path**
• **Double-click** any item → reveals immediately in Finder
• Instant keyword filter & dotfile toggle (`.*`) | --- ## Quick Installation (Zero Build Required) > **Requirements:** Google Antigravity 2.0 and Node.js (`>= 18`). Prebuilt UI assets are included in `ui/bar.html`, so **no `npm install` is needed**. Clone directly into your global Antigravity plugins directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/WEiHJ404/antigravity-finder-explorer.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/finder-explorer ``` Antigravity discovers new plugins in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` **live without requiring an app restart**: - Verify or toggle the plugin under **Skills & Customizations → Plugins → Finder Explorer**. - Open the side-pane file tree from the right-hand pane switcher (**`Workspace ⌄` → `Finder 文件树`**) or the **`+`** tab button. - Starting from your next chat turn, whenever the agent outputs deliverables, an inline **`📍 在 Finder 中显示`** bar appears automatically. --- ## Features & Platform Support - **macOS (Primary)**: Uses `/usr/bin/open -R` for Finder file highlighting, `/usr/bin/open` for default apps, and `/usr/bin/open -a Terminal` for terminal launch. Resolves symlinked workspace shortcuts cleanly so Finder highlights the true underlying file. - **Windows & Linux Compatibility**: Falls back cleanly to `explorer.exe /select,` on Windows and `xdg-open` on Linux. - **Theme Synchronization**: Automatically adapts to Antigravity Light and Dark themes in real time via host CSS tokens. - **Pinned Shortcuts**: Folders or files prefixed with `00_` are pinned to the top of the directory tree and expanded automatically. --- ## Repository Structure ```text finder-explorer/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── mcp_config.json # Registers the local stdio MCP server ├── README.md # English documentation ├── README.zh-CN.md # Simplified Chinese documentation (简体中文文档) ├── LICENSE # MIT License ├── assets/ │ └── logo.svg # Plugin icon ├── rules/ │ └── AGENTS.md # Always-on rule prompting inline Finder bars for deliverables ├── bin/ │ ├── run-mcp.sh # Portable PATH-aware Node launcher for GUI sessions │ └── finder-mcp.mjs # Zero-dependency stdio MCP server (SEP-1865 MCP App) ├── ui/ │ └── bar.html # Pre-bundled self-contained inline MCP App UI ├── sidecars/ │ └── explorer/ # Right-hand Auxiliary Pane file tree (`sidecar_sdk`) │ ├── sidecar.json │ ├── main.mjs │ ├── index.html │ ├── styles.css │ └── app.js ├── src/ │ └── bar-entry.mjs # Source for the inline MCP App UI └── scripts/ └── build-ui.mjs # Optional rebuild script (`npm run build:ui`) ``` --- ## Security & Privacy Model - **Local Loopback & Stdio Only**: Makes zero network requests; all operations stay strictly on your local machine. - **Workspace & Home Boundary Checks**: - The side-pane explorer (`sidecars/explorer/main.mjs`) verifies every directory listing and OS action against the active conversation's authorized `workspaceUris`. - The MCP server (`bin/finder-mcp.mjs`) restricts actions strictly to existing paths inside the current user's home directory and invokes OS binaries via `execFile` (never `shell: true`), preventing command injection. --- ## Development (Optional) If you modify `src/bar-entry.mjs` and wish to rebuild `ui/bar.html`: ```bash cd ~/.gemini/config/plugins/finder-explorer npm install npm run build:ui ``` ## License Released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).
